text:
Maria: Hey team — Catalyst go-live next Tue. Quick sync: quota allocation confirmed (40k tokens/min). Need autoscale policy validation + shadow load test results. Can ops/eng confirm?

Tyler: Confirmed. Quota set to 40k, reserve burst pool 10k. I'll run a shadow test this afternoon. Any target P95 latency SLA? :thinking:

Maria: P95 < 120ms for typical gen paths, < 300ms for long context (>4096). Also need error budget 0.1%. Share load script.

Lena: Sharing load script now. Use `hey` + concurrency ramp. Example:

```
hey -c 200 -q 50 -z 15m -m POST -d '{"input":"<prompt>"}' https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

Expect ~2k rps baseline for concurrency 200.

Tyler: Running smoke now. Will post logs if anything >1% 5xx.

AutoscaleBot: [11:12] autoscale-preview: policy 'gradual-burst-v2' evaluated against 15m window — estimated capacity ok, scaling delay 30s.

Ashok: Heads-up: network egress limit on Catalyst account at carrier side — they may throttle above 30k rps. Maria, have you validated with their infra?

Maria: Good catch. They signed the provisioning doc but didn't enable high-egress. Reaching out to their infra lead @Evan.

Tyler: Test #1 results: sustained 28k tokens/min, P95 98ms, CPU 75% on serving. 5xx at 0.03%. Uploading logs: https://logs.internal/txn/4720202020

Lena: Nice. Two config notes: 1) set `batch_max_tokens=4096` for steady loads. 2) enable KV cache warmup for canary. Sample config:

```
model_config:
  batch_max_tokens: 4096
  kv_cache_warm: true
  quant_profile: perf-high
```

Maria: Ops checklist for cutover:
1) Confirm egress quota with customer
2) Finalize autoscale policy and cooldowns
3) Schedule 1hr golden hour with SRE
4) Run canary with 5% traffic
5) Roll forward if metrics green.

Assign owners?

Tyler: I'll own #2 and #4. Ashok can take #3. Maria owns #1.

Ashok: Ok for golden hour. I'll shadow the canary and run kill scenarios (node kill, network delay).

AutoscaleBot: [11:46] canary-deploy: 5% traffic route created for model 'redwood-1-dedicated'. Monitoring hooks active.

Maria: One more ask — collect customer feedback loop: who's doing enablement? Lina? (typo) — actually @Lena to lead a 30m enablement call next Wed.

Lena: I'll prepare a short runbook + 10-min demo. Also want to capture 3 example prompts that cause long context blowups so we can flag regressions.

Tyler: Postmortem note: if 5xx >0.5% for 10m, automatic rollback to fallback model `redwood-1-light` triggers. Confirmed.

Maria: Great. Follow-ups: Evan (customer infra) update by EOD, Tyler posts full load logs, Ashok confirms golden hour slot, Lena posts runbook. :thumbsup: 

Evan: Evan (customer infra): Confirmed — egress bumped to 60Gbps, no ISP throttles expected. Will be on the enablement call.

Maria: Thanks all. We'll reconvene tomorrow 09:30 PT for final greenlight.
